purpose: Build ShredEQ: a zero-latency adaptive parametric, dynamic, and multiband equalizer for electric guitar and bass. C++20/JUCE plugin targeting VST3 and Standalone with external sidechain and MIDI input. 12-band parametric EQ with per-band dynamics, 4-zone multiband engine, Tight Cut resonant HPF, Chug Stabilizer, resonance/anti-fizz scanner with shared spectral analysis subsystem, note/harmonic follower, external-sidechain masking, stage-level M/S processing, optional lookahead with PDC, spectral percentile cloud analyzer, headroom histogram, and a diagnostic GUI with three view modes. Full product specification in SHREDEQ_SPEC.md.
async_strategy: Phases run sequentially. Within each phase, tasks with disjoint write paths run in parallel waves. Fan-in tasks (processBlock wiring, editor integration) depend on all upstream tasks in the same phase and are the sole owner of CMakeLists.txt, PluginProcessor, and PluginEditor within that phase. The C++ language adapter provides cmake/ctest verification inference — task verification_commands arrays are left empty.

phases.goal:
Project scaffold, build system, APVTS parameter infrastructure, and state engine.

Create the ShredEQ JUCE plugin project. Inspect ShredBoost and ShredSpace CMakeLists.txt for the known-working structure and follow the same conventions for plugin code, manufacturer code, company name, bundle ID, version, and copy-after-build policy.

CMakeLists.txt: juce_add_plugin targeting VST3 + Standalone. Enable NEEDS_MIDI_INPUT for host MIDI note following. CMakePresets.json with RelWithDebInfo configure preset and matching build/test presets. scripts/build_all.sh. JUCE as a git submodule.

PluginProcessor: configure main input bus, optional sidechain input bus, and output through AudioProcessor::BusesProperties. Implement isBusesLayoutSupported for mono, stereo, and stereo+sidechain layouts. Standalone must operate safely without sidechain. Constructor creates APVTS, processBlock stub, state save/restore with schema versioning.

ParameterIDs.h: complete stable parameter inventory for all v1.0 automatable controls. 12 bands x full parameter set (enabled, stage, type, frequency, gain, q, slope, route, dynamicMode, dynamicRange, threshold, ratio, attack, hold, release, knee, detectorSource, detectorFrequency, detectorQ, trackingSource, trackingHarmonic, lookahead). Global params: inputGain, outputGain, globalBypass, analyzerEnable, abState, profileIndex, tuningIndex. Tight Cut: enabled, frequency, slope, resonance, punchRatio, punchGain, punchQ, placement, routing, listenRemoved. Chug Stabilizer: enabled, frequency, bandwidth, maxReduction, threshold, attack, hold, release, preservePick, transientSens, dominanceSens. Multiband: enabled, crossover1-3 freq, per-zone gain/threshold/ratio/attack/release/transientEmphasis/sustainEmphasis/placement/detectorSource/autoThreshold/mode. Sidechain: source, lockInEnabled, lockInAmount, carveMaxGain, carveThreshold. M/S: sideHighPass, monoGuardEnabled, monoGuardProtection. Resonance suppressor: 6 slots x (enabled, frequency, q, maxDepth, attack, release, persistence, mode, placement, freeze). Note follower: trackingSource, harmonic, centsOffset, confidenceThreshold, smoothing, holdTime, returnTime, minFreq, maxFreq, midiPriority. Lookahead: mode (off/0.5/1/2/5ms). Output trim.

State engine: XML state with schema_version, A/B slots, factory presets loaded from Resources/Presets/ (read-only), user presets use juce::File::getSpecialLocation for per-user app data. .gitignore: build/, cmake-build-*, state/, .abracapocus/state/, .abracapocus/logs/, .abracapocus/reports/.

phases.goal:
Parametric EQ engine: coefficient library, TPT state-variable filters, 12-band parametric system, and cascade response.

Biquad coefficient library (Source/DSP/BiquadCoefficients.h/.cpp): RBJ Audio EQ Cookbook coefficients for all filter types. Slope support requires both first-order and second-order sections: 6dB/oct = one first-order, 12dB/oct = one biquad, 18dB/oct = first-order + biquad, 24dB/oct = two biquads, 36dB/oct = three biquads, 48dB/oct = four biquads. Use standard RBJ coefficient formulas for v1.0. Test actual magnitude response near Nyquist rather than claiming arbitrary analog matching.

TPT state-variable filter (Source/DSP/TPTFilter.h/.cpp): topology-preserving transform for modulation-stable sweeps. Bell, shelf, LP, HP, BP.

Parametric band class (Source/DSP/ParametricBand.h/.cpp): wraps biquad cascade or TPT per band. Holds: enabled, stageA/B, frequency, gain, Q, type, slope, stereo routing MODE (linked/unlinked/L/R/mid/side). Bands do NOT perform their own M/S encoding — they process whichever channel domain the stage router provides. 12 bands total.

Response computer (Source/DSP/ResponseComputer.h/.cpp): composite H(e^jw) at ~512 log-spaced points on message thread.

All DSP: juce::SmoothedValue, no heap allocation in process methods.

phases.goal:
Four-zone multiband engine with LR4 crossovers and per-zone dynamics.

See SHREDEQ_SPEC.md section 5 for full architecture.

LR4 crossover (Source/DSP/MultibandCrossover.h/.cpp): complementary serial tree, click-free movement, ordering protection. Reconstruction test: all zones unity = flat magnitude (tolerance-based, not sample-identical — LR4 has flat magnitude but frequency-dependent phase).

Zone processing (Source/DSP/MultibandZone.h/.cpp): per-zone dynamics reusing EnvelopeFollower.

Multiband engine (Source/DSP/MultibandEngine.h/.cpp): orchestrates split, zone processing, recombination.

phases.goal:
Note and harmonic follower with pitch detection. MUST be implemented before resonance detection because the resonance system's musical-harmonic rejection depends on an estimated f0.

Pitch detector (Source/DSP/PitchDetector.h/.cpp): YIN algorithm on conditioned downsampled signal. Runs at lower control rate on background thread. Audio thread supplies frames via lock-free FIFO. Returns: estimated frequency, confidence, timestamp, tracking state.

MIDI note tracking: f0 = 440*2^((m-69)/12) from host MIDI. Priority: lowest/highest/last.

Note follower (Source/DSP/NoteFollower.h/.cpp): harmonic targeting f_target = f0*h*2^(c/1200). Log-frequency smoothing. Confidence handling. Integrate into ParametricBand: any band can optionally attach a NoteFollower.

See SHREDEQ_SPEC.md section 9 for complete DSP math.

phases.goal:
Resonance detection, anti-fizz suppression, and shared spectral analysis subsystem.

Shared spectral analysis engine (Source/Analysis/SpectralAnalysisEngine.h/.cpp, Source/Analysis/AnalysisFifo.h/.cpp): STFT with Hann window, configurable FFT size, hop. Background thread receives audio via juce::AbstractFifo. This is the SINGLE spectral subsystem — resonance detector, percentile cloud, spectrum display, persistence map, and sidechain collision analysis all consume data from this service. Skip frames when overloaded. Fixed memory bounds.

Resonance detector (Source/DSP/ResonanceDetector.h/.cpp): persistence analysis, candidate scoring. Musical-harmonic rejection uses PitchDetector f0 from phase F — fixed peaks that persist across different notes get higher confidence than peaks following harmonics.

Suppressor slots (Source/DSP/ResonanceSuppressor.h/.cpp): 6 dynamic notch filters. Scan workflow with candidate cards.

See SHREDEQ_SPEC.md section 8 for complete DSP math.

phases.goal:
External sidechain masking, stage-level M/S processing, and optional lookahead with PDC.

Stage-level M/S router (Source/DSP/MidSideRouter.h/.cpp): performs M/S encode/decode ONCE around the parametric stages, not per-band. Bands process whichever domain the router provides. Side high-pass (configurable 120-300Hz) lives in the router.

Sidechain masking analyzer (Source/DSP/SidechainAnalyzer.h/.cpp): ERB/octave band accumulation, overlap/dominance/masking metrics. Collision map data for GUI.

Masking carver (Source/DSP/MaskingCarver.h/.cpp): applies bounded carve gains using a small number of dynamic bell filters. Suggestion mode converts collisions into editable parametric bands. Auto mode applies only explicitly enabled carver bands.

Mono Guard (Source/DSP/MonoGuard.h/.cpp): frequency-dependent L/R coherence, protection mode.

Lookahead delay (Source/DSP/LookaheadDelay.h/.cpp): preallocated circular buffer. Off, 0.5, 1, 2, 5ms. Reports exact latency via setLatencySamples. Zero samples when disabled. Click-free delay changes.

Wire all into processBlock. v1.0 uses host external sidechain only.
